question: Calculate the total revenue generated by each subcategory in the last 6 months.
golden_sql: SELECT sc.subcategoryname, SUM(b.final_amount) AS total_revenue FROM subcategories sc JOIN shop_details sd ON sd.subcategory_id = sc.id JOIN bookings b ON b.shop_id = sd.id WHERE b.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND b.status = 1 GROUP BY sc.id, sc.subcategoryname ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
